template.name: Varg 18
template.description: Twelve stations, strength alternating with cardio, no station repeats back to back. Cardio alternates run on the spot and air boxing.

music.style: hard electronic, punchy drums, dark synth bass, no vocals
music.theme: Eighteen minutes of short brutal intervals, wolf-pack pace, never a full breath

template.name: Varg 30
template.description: Varg 18 with longer work: the same twelve stations in the same order, strength alternating with cardio, but 40 seconds under load per station. Cardio alternates run on the spot and air boxing.

music.style: hard electronic, punchy drums, dark synth bass, no vocals
music.theme: Thirty minutes of long grinding intervals, wolf-pack pace held past the burn

template.name: Varg Yoga 10
template.description: Ten minutes of holds for any day: wake the spine, stand strong, balance, open the hips, a little core, then settle. Between poses you get 10 seconds to move while the voice names the next one, with form cues on screen; one-sided poses go left, then right.

music.style: calm ambient, soft pads, gentle hand percussion, no vocals
music.theme: Ten quiet minutes on the mat, breath, balance and a slow reset

template.name: Varg Yoga 20
template.description: Twenty minutes of holds: longer holds and more of everything. A sun-salutation start, standing strength and balance, core, deep hips and hamstrings, a spinal twist, and a proper rest at the end. 10 seconds to move between poses while the voice names the next one, and on-screen cues throughout.

music.style: calm ambient, warm pads, soft piano, slow hand drums, no vocals
music.theme: Twenty unhurried minutes of strength, balance and release, breathe and settle

template.name: Free ride
template.description: No program, just the bike: live watts, cadence, kcal and your power zone, with the clock counting up from the start. Ride as long as you like; Finish saves it to your history.

plan.scheme: Open-ended · live watts, cadence, kcal and zone

music.style: steady deep house, warm bass, rolling groove, no vocals
music.theme: An easy open-ended ride with no plan, just turning the pedals

template.name: Zone 2 · 40
template.description: Forty minutes in heart-rate zone 2: easy enough to talk, steady enough to build the engine. Steered by your chest strap against your Garmin zones, not by watts: start around 56–75 % FTP and let the heart rate set the effort as the ride drifts. The ride logs how much of it you spent in the zone.

plan.scheme: 40 min in heart-rate zone 2 · 85–95 rpm · needs the strap

music.style: steady deep house, warm bass, rolling groove, no vocals
music.theme: Forty easy, even minutes, a long steady engine-building ride

template.name: First to 200 kcal
template.description: A race against the clock: 200 kcal as fast as you can make them. Kcal come from the bike, so it ends itself at 200; the target is threshold and above. Pace it, then empty the tank.

plan.scheme: 200 kcal @ 95–120 % FTP · for time

music.style: hard electronic, driving drums, aggressive synth
music.theme: A flat-out calorie race, no pacing after halfway

template.name: Sweet Spot 3×10
template.description: The FTP builder: three ten-minute blocks just under threshold, five easy minutes between, a ten-minute warm-up and a five-minute spin to finish.

plan.scheme: 10 min warm-up · 3 × 10 min @ 88–94 % FTP, 5 min easy between · 5 min cool-down

music.style: progressive house, building synths, steady kick, no vocals
music.theme: Long controlled efforts just under the red line

template.name: VO2 Max 5×3
template.description: Five three-minute efforts above threshold with equal recovery. Hard from the second minute of each. That's the point.

plan.scheme: 10 min warm-up · 5 × 3 min @ 106–120 % FTP, 3 min easy between · 5 min cool-down

music.style: hard techno, pounding kick, rising tension, no vocals
music.theme: Three minutes at a time, deep in the red

template.name: Bike Tabata
template.description: Eight rounds of 20 seconds all out, 10 seconds easy, after a proper warm-up. Four minutes that feel like forty.

plan.scheme: 8 min warm-up · 8 × 20 s all out (150 %+ FTP) / 10 s easy · 6 min cool-down

music.style: frantic drum and bass, huge drops, no vocals
music.theme: Eight sprints, nothing held back

template.name: Sit · Stand · Accelerate
template.description: Ten one-minute rounds: 20 seconds seated, 20 standing, 20 accelerating, no rest between. The music follows the blocks: one song set, low seated, mid standing, its peak accelerating, a different song each round.

plan.scheme: 10 × (20 s seated @ 75–85 % FTP / 20 s standing @ 90–105 % FTP, 60–75 rpm / 20 s accelerate @ 110–130 % FTP, 105–120 rpm) · 5 min cool-down

music.style: driving tech house, punchy kick, rolling bassline, no vocals
music.theme: Sit, stand, accelerate, a minute at a time, the music lifting with every block

template.name: Calorie Ladder
template.description: A race up a ladder: 50, 100, then 150 kcal at threshold, with three easy minutes between rungs. The clock never stops: the score is your total time.

plan.scheme: 50 kcal · 3 min easy · 100 kcal · 3 min easy · 150 kcal @ 95–110 % FTP · for time

music.style: driving electro, big bassline, no vocals
music.theme: Climb the ladder, every rung longer than the last

template.name: Fran
template.description: The sprint benchmark: thrusters and pull-ups, 21-15-9. Short and savage: most finish between 3 and 10 minutes.

plan.scheme: 21-15-9 thrusters @ 43/29 kg · pull-ups · for time

music.style: aggressive industrial metal, pounding drums
music.theme: Three minutes of pure redline, no pacing, just go

template.name: Fran (scaled)
template.description: Fran for before your first pull-up: the same 21-15-9, with a light bar and ring rows. Set the rings so the last rows are hard but clean.

plan.scheme: 21-15-9 thrusters @ 20/15 kg · ring rows · for time

music.style: driving electronic rock, heavy kick
music.theme: Short and sharp, learn to suffer for a few minutes

template.name: Helen
template.description: Three rounds of a run, kettlebell swings and pull-ups.

plan.scheme: 3 rounds: 400 m run · 21 kettlebell swings @ 24/16 kg · 12 pull-ups · for time

music.style: hard rock, galloping drums, distorted bass
music.theme: Run, swing, pull, three hard laps

template.name: Helen (scaled)
template.description: Helen with a lighter bell and ring rows in place of pull-ups.

plan.scheme: 3 rounds: 400 m run · 21 kettlebell swings @ 16/12 kg · 12 ring rows · for time

music.style: punchy rock, steady drive
music.theme: Three honest rounds, keep moving

template.name: Jackie
template.description: Row, thrusters, pull-ups: one long chipper, one lap each.

plan.scheme: 1000 m row · 50 thrusters @ 20/15 kg · 30 pull-ups · for time

music.style: dark electronic, rolling bassline, hard drums
music.theme: Pull the erg, then grind through the bar

template.name: Jackie (scaled)
template.description: Jackie with a training bar and ring rows.

plan.scheme: 1000 m row · 50 thrusters @ 15/10 kg · 30 ring rows · for time

music.style: dark electronic, steady groove
music.theme: A long steady chipper, find a rhythm and hold it

template.name: Karen
template.description: One movement, one number: 150 wall balls. Break them into sets before you have to: 10s or 15s with short rests.

plan.scheme: 150 wall balls @ 9/6 kg to a 3 m target · for time

music.style: relentless techno, four-on-the-floor
music.theme: Squat, throw, catch, one hundred and fifty times

template.name: Kelly
template.description: Five long rounds of running, jumping and throwing: a lung burner.

plan.scheme: 5 rounds: 400 m run · 30 box jumps @ 60/50 cm · 30 wall balls @ 9/6 kg · for time

music.style: hard electronic rock, big drums
music.theme: Five rounds of lungs and legs, keep the engine running

template.name: Annie
template.description: Double-unders and sit-ups in a descending ladder.

plan.scheme: 50-40-30-20-10 double-unders · sit-ups · for time

music.style: fast drum and bass, crisp breaks
music.theme: Quick feet, hard core, a ladder down to the finish

template.name: Annie (scaled)
template.description: Annie with single-unders while the double-unders come.

plan.scheme: 50-40-30-20-10 single-unders · sit-ups · for time

music.style: upbeat drum and bass
music.theme: Light on the feet, skip, crunch, repeat

template.name: Half Murph (scaled)
template.description: Half of Murph, scaled for before your first pull-up: ring rows in place of pull-ups, no vest. Push-ups from the knees or with hands on a box are fine. Partition the middle however you like.

plan.scheme: 800 m run · 50 ring rows · 100 push-ups · 150 air squats · 800 m run · for time

music.style: aggressive electronic rock, pounding drums
music.theme: Half the hero, all the honour, earn the full one

template.name: Pull-up Path 1
template.description: For when a pull-up is still out of reach. Hangs build the grip, scapular pulls the first inch, rows the back, and slow negatives the strength to pull. Two or three times a week. Ready for Path 2 when you can hang the full 30 s and lower for 3–5 s on every negative.

music.style: steady hip-hop beat, heavy bass, no vocals
music.theme: Patient strength, one more second on the bar each week

template.name: Pull-up Path 2
template.description: The next step: longer hangs and negatives, band-assisted pull-ups and rows. Use the thinnest band that still lets you do clean reps; when that band gets easy, try one strict pull-up at the start of the session.

music.style: boom-bap hip-hop beat, deep bass, no vocals
music.theme: Closing in on the first pull-up, grind and believe

template.name: Rasteplads
template.description: Rest-stop reset after one to two hours behind the wheel. Standing only: nothing goes on the tarmac. Opens the hips the seat closed down, unlocks the shoulders, moves blood without soaking your shirt for the next leg.

music.style: motorik krautrock, hypnotic driving rhythm, analog synth, no vocals
music.theme: Four and a half minutes at a roadside stop, no pauses, shake the highway out of the legs and get back on the road

template.name: Grundtræning
template.description: Basic soldier conditioning circuit, inspired by Træn med Forsvaret. Push-ups, air squats, sit-ups, burpees, run on the spot.

music.style: nordic electronic rock, driving drums, cold synths
music.theme: Danish soldier basic training, disciplined, no-nonsense grind

template.name: Feltmarch
template.description: March training under load, inspired by Træn med Forsvaret.

plan.scheme: 10 km march · 10 kg pack · steady pace

music.style: marching drums, nordic folk undertones, hypnotic low drone
music.theme: Field march across Danish terrain, endless steady kilometres

template.name: Kredsløbstræning
template.description: Cardio circuit intervals, inspired by Træn med Forsvaret. Run on the spot, kettlebell swings, burpees.

music.style: high-energy drum and bass, relentless breakbeats
music.theme: Circuit intervals, heart pounding, quick transitions

template.name: Murph
template.description: In memory of Lt. Michael Murphy. Traditionally done wearing a 9 kg vest.

plan.scheme: 1.6 km run · 100 pull-ups · 200 push-ups · 300 air squats · 1.6 km run · for time

music.style: aggressive electronic rock, pounding drums, distorted guitar
music.theme: Relentless hero tribute, pain, honor, pushing past the limit

template.name: ACFT (Army Combat Fitness Test)
template.description: Six-event test of combat readiness. Log each event's score.

plan.scheme: 3-rep deadlift · power throw · hand-release push-ups · sprint-drag-carry · plank · 3.2 km run

music.style: hard military trap, heavy 808s, snare cadence
music.theme: Combat readiness test, focused aggression under pressure

template.name: USMC PFT
template.description: Physical Fitness Test: max effort on each event.

plan.scheme: Pull-ups (max) · plank (max hold) · 4.8 km run (for time)

music.style: hard rock, driving double-time drums
music.theme: Max effort test day, no slack, all out

template.name: Navy PRT
template.description: Physical Readiness Test.

plan.scheme: Forearm plank (max) · push-ups 2:00 · 2.4 km run

music.style: electronic rock, steady pulse
music.theme: Disciplined readiness, steady grind to the finish

template.name: Cindy
template.description: Cindy is a 20-minute AMRAP: 5 pull-ups, 10 push-ups, 15 air squats, as many rounds as possible. The guided player counts the clock, not rounds, so this is the timed adaptation.

music.style: fast punk rock, upbeat and raw
music.theme: Twenty minutes of relentless rounds, keep moving

template.name: Full Body EMOM - 20 Minutes
template.description: Two minutes of warm-up, then 18 minutes on the minute: a new exercise at the top of every minute, whatever is left of the minute is rest. Six stations, three rounds, the reps climbing each round. A jump rope, and a resistance band or loaded backpack for the rows.

music.style: driving hard electronic, heavy kick, gritty synth bass, no vocals
music.theme: Every minute on the minute, attack the work, steal the rest, three rounds

template.name: Kettlebell EMOM - 20 Minutes
template.description: One kettlebell, twenty minutes. Two minutes of warm-up, then 18 minutes on the minute: swings, goblet squats, clean and press, skipping to breathe, rows, dead bugs. Three rounds, the reps climbing each round; the rest of the minute is rest.

music.style: heavy industrial electronic, iron-hammer percussion, dark bass, no vocals
music.theme: Swinging iron every minute on the minute, three rounds, no wasted breath

template.name: Standard Ruck
template.description: Foot-march standard: 19.3 km with a 16 kg dry pack.

plan.scheme: 19.3 km ruck · 16 kg load · target sub-3:00 · for time

music.style: dark folk percussion, marching cadence, low drone
music.theme: Long ruck under load, one step after another for hours

template.name: DT
template.description: In memory of USAF SSgt Timothy Davis.

plan.scheme: 5 rounds: 12 deadlifts · 9 hang power cleans · 6 push press @ 70/48 kg · for time

music.style: heavy metal, barbell-slamming riffs
music.theme: Five brutal barbell rounds in tribute, heavy and fast

template.name: Varg Mobility 5
template.description: Daily mobility, short form. Six stations through ankles, hips, spine and shoulders, straight through with no rest; the station change is the breather. Floor work included; do it every day, not just leg day.

music.style: calm ambient, soft pads, minimal percussion, no vocals
music.theme: Five minutes to unlock stiff joints before the day starts, unhurried, deliberate breath

template.name: Varg Mobility 20
template.description: Daily mobility, full form. Eight stations through ankles, hips, spine and shoulders across three rounds, straight through with no rest. Floor work included: the long version for a rest day or a stiff morning.

music.style: spacious ambient drone, slow evolving textures, gentle rhythmic pulse, no vocals
music.theme: Twenty minutes moving through hips, spine, shoulders and ankles, patient, full range, a wolf stretching out before the hunt

template.name: Chad 1000x
template.description: 1,000 box step-ups with a rucksack. Honors LT Chad Wilkinson.

plan.scheme: 1000 step-ups @ 50 cm box · 20/16 kg ruck · for time

music.style: somber cinematic percussion, steady stomping beat
music.theme: A thousand step-ups in remembrance, solemn, unbroken rhythm

music.style: driving hard electronic, heavy kick, gritty synth bass, no vocals
music.theme: Every minute on the minute, attack the work, steal the rest, three rounds
